section_summary.extract_value: This is a Measures section describing the assessment instruments used in a study. The section details four main measurement tools: the Drive for Muscularity Scale (DMS) with 15 items measuring desire for muscularity, the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) with 13 items measuring positive body image, the Neuroticism-Extraversion-Openness-Five-Factor Inventory (NEO-FFI) measuring Big Five personality domains, and the McArthur Ladder of Subjective Social Status (MLSSS) measuring perceived social status. Additionally, demographic information including age, ethnicity, educational qualifications, height, and weight (used to compute self-reported BMI) were collected. The text references 'the present study' suggesting a single study context, though no explicit study numbering is provided.
